table.retrieve:
SELECT
	MotorVehicleCode,
	Name,
	MotorVehicleTypeCode,
	OriginalDate,
	Date,
	ChasisNo,
	EngineNo,
	Model,
	Color,
	EnginePower,
	Area,
	CustCode,
	RegNo,
	RefNo,
	RefNo2,
	RefNo3,
	RefNo4,
	RefNo5,
	ToolKit,
	SpareTyre,
	OriginalKeys,
	WarrantyBook
FROM 
	DBO.MotorVehicle
WHERE 
		Chasisno LIKE (CASE WHEN :as_chasisno='' OR :as_chasisno IS NULL THEN '«»' ELSE :as_chasisno END) OR
		Name LIKE (CASE WHEN :as_name='' OR :as_name IS NULL THEN '«»' ELSE :as_name END) OR 
		EngineNo LIKE (CASE WHEN :as_EngineNo='' OR :as_EngineNo IS NULL THEN '«»' ELSE :as_EngineNo END) OR 
		RegNo LIKE (CASE WHEN :as_RegNo='' OR :as_RegNo IS NULL THEN '«»' ELSE :as_RegNo END) OR
		Model LIKE (CASE WHEN :as_Model='' OR :as_Model IS NULL THEN '«»' ELSE :as_Model END) OR
		color LIKE (CASE WHEN :as_color='' OR :as_color IS NULL THEN '«»' ELSE :as_color END)
